replies.text: Reading the diff and still not knowing is the honest part of this. Keep the prompt in a file instead of scrolling back for it, so the diff has something fixed to check against.
The rooting is what makes this more than a photo frame. A screen you can put a modern browser on at that price is a good deal.
"Where they talk about sleep" landing on a podcast segment is the one that gets me. One query, four kinds of files, no filenames needed.
One addition: drop queued jobs when the PR closes or the branch is force-pushed. The commit SHA protects the results, but the pending job still burns tokens.
